primary.title: Sizes, shapes, and albedos of the inner satellites of Neptune
primary.author: Erich Karkoschka
primary.access: Publisher search index exposes abstract; direct web open and local HTTP request return403. Full paper not obtained or assessed.
primary.licence: No CC licence verified; no paper figure embedded.

sources.kind: Actual inaccessible publisher HTML response; hash is NOT a paper or accessible abstract hash.

assessment.evidence: Publisher-indexed abstract, inspected2026-10-12; search result is not a retained full-paper source.
assessment.interpretation: Triaxial ellipsoid fit semiaxes, not three diameters. No conversion to a registered shape, surface normal or observed local terrain adopted.
assessment.dataset: Abstract describes87 resolved Voyager images across five innermost moons; this does not identify the retained NASA trio JPEG or provide its acquisition/product crosswalk.
assessment.radiusAlternatives: Retain Brozovic2019 adopted75±3km and JPL74±10km equivalent-volume radius as distinct source values; no new radius/uncertainty inferred from abstract.
assessment.photometry: Abstract discusses revised sizes with historical Voyager photometry. This does not calibrate current publisher JPEG colour or establish local chemistry.
